description:
Per RFO FAR 5.101(c)

Contracting Office Address: U.S. Army Mission and Installation Contracting Command – Fort Knox (MICC – Ft Knox), 199 6th Avenue, Suite 250, Fort Knox, KY 40121-5720

Set-aside Status: Other Than Full and Open Competition

Subject: Synopsis of Solicitation for 6BDE Broward County STEM

Solicitation Number: W9124D26QA199

Description: This is a non-personal service contract to provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items necessary to perform services as described in the PWS. The contractor shall provide contractual support for JCLC Camp STEM Challenge 2026, for a maximum of 350 Cadets and 50 Cadres.

The MICC - Ft Knox intends to award a contract, on a sole source basis in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.103, to Nova Southeastern University for 6BDE Broward County STEM to support the U.S. Army Cadet Command with a period of performance of 7-12 June 2026.

This solicitation will not be available through SAM.gov. Interested parties may contact Samuel M. Henderson, Contracting Officer, and Amber Goetz, Contract Specialist to be considered by the MICC - Ft Knox.
